title.zh: 电化学 · 电子沿导线跑，还是被电推着跑
title.en: Electrochemistry · Electrons Running Down the Wire, or Pushed Along

desc.zh: 氧化还原反应被拆成两个半电池：自发时电子沿导线流出电流（原电池），外加电压反推时就是电解池。
desc.en: A redox reaction is split into two half-cells: spontaneously it drives a current through the wire (a galvanic cell), and an applied opposing voltage turns it into an electrolytic cell.
